summary: Design reliable lakehouse pipelines, quality controls, and analytics layers. Explore the five-day course and practical architecture exercises.
lede: Modern data architecture and lakehouse engineering covers how teams organize data flows, storage layers, quality controls, and analytics access. It is for data engineers, BI developers, analytics managers, and platform or architecture professionals planning dependable pipelines for reporting and AI workloads. Through practical design exercises, learners map Medallion layers, assess storage and orchestration choices, and define data-quality checks, lineage, and phased implementation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, build, govern, or use enterprise data pipelines and analytics platforms. It suits practitioners who need to align data engineering decisions with BI, operational reporting, and emerging AI workloads.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of relational databases, SQL concepts, and business reporting is recommended. No programming is required to complete the course; exercises focus on architecture, workflow mapping, and analysis of supplied case data. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted anomaly detection receive conceptual awareness treatment rather than implementation training.
